How do the options compare?

Requirement opt-a: Notify per warrant total opt-b: Executor emits one event per claim action (chosen) opt-c: Orchestrator keeps a claim ledger
FR-1 The end user is told about every block, unblock and confiscation ✓ ✓ ✓
FR-2 A notification for a warrant with many claims names the claims behind the action ✗ ✓ ✓
FR-3 The end user gets one notification for each action, not one for each claim ✓ ✓ ◐
NFR-1 The notification arrives soon after the action ✓ ✗ ◐
NFR-2 A failed notification never blocks or undoes an action ◐ ✓ ✓
